claims.claim: Epomis circumscriptus is a ground beetle in the family Carabidae, and the featured animal is its larval stage.
Epomis circumscriptus has three larval instars.

Later Epomis circumscriptus larvae can range from pale yellow-brown or whitish with black and orange markings to nearly black with orange markings; legs and terminal urogomphi are yellow, and dark mandibles have reddish tips.
Epomis larvae and amphibians co-occur in moist habitat and can share shelters such as stones and wood debris.

Specialized double-hooked mandibles help the larva attach firmly to amphibian skin.
